latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release — launch of cloud-based video editing and export tool.

- Upload raw video (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM up to 500MB) for fast, AI-powered editing and 1080p export.
- Automatically connects and manages tokens and session setup for a seamless start.
- Supports common editing actions: trim, add transitions, enhance audio, text overlays, and adjust aspect ratio.
- Simple commands for checking credits, status, and exporting finished videos.
- Fast processing: typical 1–2 minute turnaround on short clips.
- Full support for batch uploads, iterative edits, and timeline previews.
